rationale: Use the 1,143 introduced-only butterfly x WGSRPD3 cells supported by exactly one introduced known host as the primary identity-specific timing test. This fixes resource richness at one and avoids making the temporal null depend on how many host plants a cell contains.

primary_panel.source: Outcome-blind HOSTS-WCVP introduced-only resource panel for the frozen 31 butterfly species

actual_resource_clock: Earliest exact-WGSRPD3 GBIF record from 1800-2025 for the single documented known host that WCVP classifies as introduced in that cell.

paired_pseudoresource.rule: Choose the nearest matched alien non-host plant introduced in the same WGSRPD3 region.
exclusions: any documented host of the focal butterfly
plants not introduced in the focal WGSRPD3 region
paired_pseudoresource.tie_break: deterministic accepted plant name then WCVP plant id
paired_pseudoresource.resource_richness: exactly one actual host versus exactly one pseudo-resource per cell

butterfly_clock: Earliest exact-WGSRPD3 GBIF record from 1800-2025 for the focal butterfly, from the frozen full-history/bulk-history reconstruction.

primary_endpoint.inclusion: Cells with a butterfly first record and dated local records for both actual and paired pseudo-resource.
primary_endpoint.statistic: Paired difference in resource lead: (butterfly_year - actual_host_year) - (butterfly_year - pseudo_host_year) = pseudo_host_year - actual_host_year.
primary_endpoint.interpretation: Positive values mean the actual known host was documented earlier than its matched alien non-host control.
primary_endpoint.test: One-sided paired sign/randomization test of whether actual known hosts are earlier than matched pseudo-resources; report median paired year difference and fraction actual-earlier.

secondary: All 2,035 introduced-only cells using the richness-preserving multi-host pseudo-resource null from v0.1
Sensitivity using the 2nd and 3rd nearest matched pseudo-resource instead of only the nearest
Host-before-butterfly fraction and signed lag distribution
Right-censored no-butterfly cells only if the primary identity-specific test is positive

interpretation_rules.supported: Actual known hosts are locally documented earlier than matched alien non-host plants in the same regions. This supports identity-specific resource-consumer temporal mismatch.
interpretation_rules.unsupported: Actual hosts are no earlier than matched alien non-hosts. Apparent long lags are generic alien-plant/collection chronology rather than known-resource tracking.

boundaries: First records are detection/digitization dates, not establishment dates.
Known-host presence does not prove local larval use or demographic benefit.
The original GEB main paper remains unchanged unless independently validated.
Do not call the result invasion debt or trophic debt unless the identity-specific paired test is positive and robust.
stop_rule: If the paired single-host primary test is null, terminate the temporal-mismatch branch rather than adding more timing or simulation variants.

prespecified_summaries: median paired pseudo-minus-actual resource year within each butterfly species
median paired pseudo-minus-actual resource year within each actual host species
median paired pseudo-minus-actual resource year within each WGSRPD3 region
cluster_robustness.tests: One-sided exact sign tests over nonzero cluster medians.
cluster_robustness.generality_gate: Broad generality is claimed only if the cell-level timing test is positive and both butterfly-species and actual-host cluster direction tests are positive at p <= 0.05.
cluster_robustness.failure_interpretation: If the cell-level result is positive but cluster direction fails, describe the timing effect as concentrated in particular butterflies or hosts rather than as a general resource-tracking principle.
